name: @jetcrab/pi-desk-remote-debug
description: Pi Desk single-entry remote debugging gateway and tunnel UI

zh-CN.description: 统一管理远程调试入口和隧道，在 Pi Desk 中访问开发服务。

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('dist/browser',{recursive:true,force:true});for(const name of fs.readdirSync('dist'))if(name.startsWith('browser')&&['.js','.d.ts','.js.map'].some(ext=>name.endsWith(ext)))fs.rmSync('dist/'+name,{force:true})" && esbuild src/browser-entry.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='production' --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react/jsx-dev-runtime --external:react-dom --external:react-dom/client --external:@jetcrab/pi-desk-sdk/react/base --external:@jetcrab/pi-desk-sdk/react/markdown --outdir=dist/browser --entry-names=entry --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash]
